# Implementation-Readiness Checklist: TRACE Phase 2 — F02: Repository / Code Analyzer

**Purpose**: Rigorous requirements-quality and implementation-readiness validation for TRACE Phase 2 (F02: Repository / Code Analyzer), verifying completeness, clarity, testability, architectural isolation, evidence-backed determinism, and integration boundaries before planning and execution.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context, TRACE README baseline, Phase 0/F01 architecture, and TRACE Constitution principles.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Requirements & Scope Boundaries

- [x] CHK001 Is the F02 scope explicitly bounded to static code analysis and software intelligence extraction, distinguishing it from repository management (F01), dependency graphing (F03), and commit diffing (F04)? [Completeness, Spec §Overview & Scope Boundaries]
- [x] CHK002 Is Python explicitly defined as the sole supported programming language for F02, with multi-language implementations strictly deferred to future phases? [Clarity, Spec §Overview, §FR-002, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK003 Is deterministic static analysis mandated as the primary discovery mechanism across all files, modules, classes, functions, calls, and relationships? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §NFR-005, Constitution §II]
- [x] CHK004 Does the specification strictly forbid mandatory external LLM provider calls (e.g., OpenRouter, OpenAI) for core code discovery and AST parsing, ensuring offline functionality? [Traceability, Spec §SC-006, §NFR-005, Constitution §I, §VI]
- [x] CHK005 Is the boundary with Phase 3A (F03: Dependency Graph) unambiguous, explicitly prohibiting F02 from creating Neo4j nodes, relationship edges, or running Cypher queries? [Consistency, Spec §NFR-003, §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK006 Is the boundary with Phase 3B (F04: Version / Change Analyzer) explicit, defining F02 as a single-commit/ref code intelligence extractor and deferring multi-commit diffing and change impact analysis to F04/F05? [Traceability, Spec §Overview & Scope Boundaries]

---

## 2. Architecture & Domain Design

- [x] CHK007 Is a generic, language-agnostic `CodeAnalyzer` interface/protocol specified in the domain layer to enable future language additions without altering business logic? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Constitution §XIV]
- [x] CHK008 Is `PythonCodeAnalyzer` specified as an isolated adapter implementation that encapsulates standard library AST parsing away from domain entities? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §User Story 4]
- [x] CHK009 Are all core code intelligence concepts modeled as strongly typed, immutable domain models (`RepositoryAnalysis`, `Module`, `Class`, `Function`, `Service`, `Import`, `Call`, `APIEndpoint`, `SourceLocation`) rather than untyped dictionaries? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK010 Does the specification prohibit exposing raw AST nodes (`ast.AST`) outside the analyzer implementation boundary? [Security, Spec §User Story 4, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK011 Is the integration boundary with F01 explicitly specified, with `analysis_runs.repository_id` as the authoritative foreign key and `repositories.last_analysis_run_id` as an optional denormalized convenience reference? [Traceability, Spec §F01 Foundation Integration, §FR-025, §FR-026]
- [x] CHK012 Is the `AnalysisRun` lifecycle state machine explicitly defined with states `PENDING`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `COMPLETED`, and `FAILED`? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK013 Is a dual-tier persistence model clearly defined, storing `AnalysisRun` state and summary metrics in PostgreSQL while saving the detailed `RepositoryAnalysis` domain aggregate as a versioned JSON artifact? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-025, §FR-027]

---

## 3. Structural Entity Analysis Capabilities

- [x] CHK014 Are file inventory requirements specified to catalog relative path, file type, byte size, and parsing status across all repository files? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK015 What constitutes a Python module explicitly defined (any `.py` file, mapped to dot-separated module paths relative to repository or source root)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK016 Are package identification rules explicitly documented, identifying packages via `__init__.py` markers and namespace package hierarchies (`is_package: bool`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK017 Are class extraction requirements fully specified (name, fully qualified name, base class expressions, decorators, docstrings, and line ranges)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK018 Are function and method extraction requirements fully specified (name, qualified name, enclosing class, kind enum, parameters, return type annotations, decorators, docstrings, line coordinates)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK019 Are class inheritance hierarchies captured via `EXTENDS` relationships linking derived classes to their explicit base class references? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK020 Are decorators represented as structured descriptors capturing decorator name, raw expression string, and line numbers rather than opaque strings? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010, §Clarifications]

---

## 4. Reference & Relationship Analysis Capabilities

- [x] CHK021 Are import statements specified to capture import kind (`IMPORT` vs `IMPORT_FROM`), source module, imported symbol, alias, relative dots, and internal vs. external classification? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK022 Are function and method calls specified to capture caller qualified name, callee expression, resolved target (if resolvable), and static resolution status (`RESOLVED_INTERNAL`, `RESOLVED_EXTERNAL`, `UNRESOLVED_DYNAMIC`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK023 Is static call resolution behavior explicitly defined when target resolution is ambiguous or dynamic, marking the call `UNRESOLVED_DYNAMIC` and prohibiting fabricated `CALLS` edges? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §FR-020, Constitution §I]
- [x] CHK024 Are web API endpoint detection rules specified for common Python frameworks (FastAPI and Flask route decorators), capturing HTTP method, path pattern, and handler function? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK025 Are configuration references specified to identify `os.environ` lookups, `os.getenv` calls, and Pydantic `BaseSettings`/`SettingsConfigDict` attribute usages (`CONFIGURED_BY`, `READS`)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK026 Are database references specified to identify SQLAlchemy declarative models (`__tablename__`, `DeclarativeBase`) and session execution/query points (`MODEL_DECLARATION`, `QUERY`, `WRITE`)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK027 Are test references specified to identify test files (`test_*.py`, `tests/`), test functions/classes, and their target components under test (`TESTED_BY`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK028 Are documentation references specified to capture module/class/function docstrings and top-level documentation files (`README.md`, `docs/`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, etc.) (`DOCUMENTED_BY`)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK029 Are external dependencies specified to be extracted deterministically from dependency manifests (`pyproject.toml`, `requirements.txt`, `setup.cfg`, `setup.py`) (`DEPENDS_ON`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, §FR-019]

## 5. Evidence & Source Coordinates

- [x] CHK030 Does every discovered entity require a `SourceLocation` value object containing relative POSIX file path, start line (1-indexed), end line, and optional column offsets? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK031 Does every discovered symbol specify rules for generating deterministic, globally qualified names (e.g., `pkg.module.ClassName.method_name`) to prevent name collisions across modules? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK032 Does every synthesized `AnalysisRelationship` require concrete source coordinates and evidence locations pointing to inspectable repository code? [Traceability, Spec §FR-019, §SC-004, Constitution §I]
- [x] CHK033 Does the specification explicitly prohibit creating hypothetical, synthetic, or probabilistic relationship edges when static repository evidence is absent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, §SC-004, Constitution §I]

---

## 6. Error Handling & Fault Tolerance

- [x] CHK034 Is file-level fault tolerance explicitly required, ensuring a syntax error (`SyntaxError`, `IndentationError`) in one file does not abort the overall repository analysis? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK035 Does the specification define an `AnalysisDiagnostic` domain model capturing file path, line, column, severity (`ERROR`, `WARNING`, `INFO`), diagnostic code, and human-readable message? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK036 Is partial analysis behavior unambiguously defined: an analysis run with some failed files completes with status `COMPLETED` and records diagnostic counts, whereas a run where zero files can be processed terminates with `FAILED`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023, §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK037 Are unreadable files, non-UTF-8 character encodings, large files (>1MB), and symlinks handled gracefully with diagnostics or skip flags rather than unhandled crashes? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-021]
- [x] CHK038 Is empty repository behavior specified, completing successfully with zero modules, zero errors, and an informational diagnostic? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK039 Are circular imports explicitly addressed, ensuring static AST parsing does not enter infinite recursion? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK040 Are directory exclusion rules specified to prune `.git`, virtual environments (`.venv`, `venv`), caches (`__pycache__`, `.pytest_cache`), build artifacts (`build`, `dist`), and `node_modules` by default? [Security, Spec §FR-004, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK041 Is support for custom user exclusion patterns specified via the analysis request contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-024]

## 7. API Contracts & Service Integration

- [x] CHK042 Is the analysis initiation route (`POST /api/v1/repositories/{repository_id}/analyze`) specified to dispatch asynchronously via an `AnalysisExecutor` abstraction and return HTTP 202 Accepted with the pending `AnalysisRun` envelope? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-024, §US3]
- [x] CHK043 Is the analysis run listing route (`GET /api/v1/repositories/{repository_id}/analyses`) specified with pagination parameters and status filtering? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK044 Is the analysis run status route (`GET /api/v1/analyses/{analysis_run_id}`) specified to return run metadata, lifecycle status, duration, and summary counts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK045 Are granular inspection endpoints specified for querying discovered entities (`/entities`), structural relationships (`/relationships`), summary metrics (`/summary`), and diagnostics (`/diagnostics`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK046 Are domain-specific HTTP status codes defined for missing repositories (404), archived projects (409), and in-progress conflicts? [Consistency, Spec §US3, Phase 0/F01 Error Model]
- [x] CHK047 Are all request and response payloads specified as strongly typed Pydantic schemas with ISO 8601 UTC timestamp formatting? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, Phase 0 Architecture]

## 8. Determinism, Testing & Quality Gates

- [x] CHK048 Does the specification require all unit and service tests to run 100% deterministically with zero live external network or LLM API calls? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008, §NFR-005, Constitution §VII]
- [x] CHK049 Are deterministic Python fixture repositories explicitly defined covering multi-module packages, inheritance, decorators, calls, API routes, config usage, database models, tests, and dependencies? [Completeness, Spec §NFR-010]
- [x] CHK050 Are specific negative test fixtures required for syntax errors, unreadable files, empty repositories, and ignored directory pruning? [Coverage, Spec §NFR-010]
- [x] CHK051 Are integration test specifications defined to verify API contract behavior (`POST` 202 Accepted, polling `GET` 200 OK) using test doubles for persistence and Git acquisition? [Completeness, Spec §US3, §NFR-009]
- [x] CHK052 Is an overall test coverage threshold of at least 80% line and branch coverage explicitly mandated across all new F02 modules? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-011, Constitution §XVI]
- [x] CHK053 Does the specification require all existing Phase 0 and F01 tests and all F02 tests to remain green with zero regressions? [Consistency, Spec §SC-008, Constitution §XV]
- [x] CHK054 Are structured logging requirements specified using `structlog` for analysis lifecycle events (`run_id`, `repository_id`, `status`, `duration_ms`) with strict secret redaction? [Observability, Spec §NFR-007, §NFR-008, Constitution §IX, §XI]
- [x] CHK055 Is analysis reproducibility explicitly specified such that re-analyzing the identical repository commit and configuration produces identical output? [Consistency, Spec §NFR-006, Constitution §XII]
